**Yes, gentle-eye has a 1fps monitor-capture method** (`start_recording`, default 1fps, records the screen). So switching to gentle-eye wouldn't fix the gap — the fix is getting that window onto the visible Space, OR capturing the window by its ID directly (which reads the window's backing store regardless of Space).
